model_output.verdict: Your hospital nursing and weekend charge work fit the kind of care Triangle Regional needs. I’d hesitate because I can’t tell your usual patient assignment or whether your RN license meets North Carolina’s requirement.
write_up: It’s common for nursing resumes to list the core duties of patient care without showing much about the patients or the unit. Yours follows that pattern at Riverside Methodist and Mount Carmel East, so it won’t stand out in a pile for this medical-surgical role.

Your Epic line is the best model: it names both the work and the system you used. Your RN, BLS and ACLS credentials are easy to find, but the resume doesn’t identify the state or status of your RN license.

Let’s start with your current patient-care line. Add your usual assignment and unit if you can, then show what your weekend charge and preceptor duties involve. Bring your Epic experience forward for this application.

cards.line: - Provide direct patient care for adult patients across 12-hour shifts
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see that you care for adults, but not what unit you work on or how many patients you typically handle. The job asks about a patient assignment of 5 to 6.
cards.example: Provide direct patient care for [number] adult patients on [unit] across 12-hour shifts
cards.question: What unit do you work on, and how many patients are typically in your assignment?

cards.line: - Administer medications and monitor patient response
cards.cannot_tell: Medication administration is central to the job, but this could describe many nursing roles. The medications and responses you monitor would show more of your daily work.
cards.question: What medications do you commonly administer, and what patient responses do you monitor?

cards.line: - Educate patients and families on discharge plans
cards.cannot_tell: Discharge education fits the role, but the topics you cover are left open. A recruiter can’t tell what patients and families rely on you to explain.
cards.example: Educate patients and families on discharge plans, including [education topics]
cards.question: What discharge topics do you commonly explain to patients and families?

cards.line: - Serve as charge nurse on weekends
cards.cannot_tell: Charge nurse is worth keeping, but the line doesn’t say what you handle in that role. Your responsibilities would show what changes when you’re in charge.
cards.example: Serve as charge nurse on weekends, handling [charge nurse responsibilities]
cards.question: What are your responsibilities when you serve as charge nurse?

cards.line: - Precept new graduate nurses
cards.cannot_tell: The posting includes precepting, and you already do it. The line doesn’t say what you teach or how many new graduates you’ve precepted.
cards.example: Precept [number] new graduate nurses on [skills or tasks]
cards.question: How many new graduate nurses have you precepted, and what have you taught them?

cards.question: What types of surgery did your patients have, and what care did you provide before and after?
